title: Months of Interest Earned on a Security Deposit Anniversary
content:
Interest on a Security Deposit is earned only for months of satisfactory payment on the secured Electric Service Agreement. A year that earns fewer than 12 months of interest is credited for those months only, out of the 12 months of a full year.

**Counting.** The payments and lapses of the year being credited are counted over the 12 months ending on the day the credit is booked, which is the anniversary. Late payment charges on the secured Electric Service Agreement are counted after deducting one for each courtesy late-charge waiver credit posted in the year.

| In the year being credited | Months of interest earned |
|---|---|
| A reconnection charge was posted on any of the customer's Electric Service Agreements, or a payment reversal was posted on the secured agreement, or 3 or more late payment charges are counted | 6 |
| 1 or more but fewer than 3 late payment charges are counted, with no payment reversal and no reconnection charge | 9 |
| Otherwise | 12 |

## Truth table (hypothetical years)

| Late payment charges posted | Courtesy waiver credits | Counted | Payment reversal on the secured agreement | Reconnection charge on any agreement | Months earned |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 0 | No | No | 12 |
| 2 | 1 | 1 | No | No | 9 |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | No | No | 9 |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | No | No | 9 |
| 3 | 0 | 3 | No | No | 6 |
| 0 | 0 | 0 | Yes | No | 6 |
| 1 | 0 | 1 | No | Yes, on another agreement | 6 |
| 1 | 1 | 0 | No | No | 12 |
